01 — CANTTELL: a skip link hidden until it takes focus, on the only page available

RGAA 12.7.2 asks that the skip link be visible, at least on focus, and sit at the same place on every page. In a browser the link shows on focus, so only its place on the other pages is asked about, since no crawl.skipLinks probe is given. Without a layout its visibility is asked about too.
